C005c.definition: the technology and the policy and procedures for its use that protect ePHI and control access to it

C008a.definition: an interconnected set of information resources under the same direct management control that shares common functionality

C008b.note: Proposed new definition, not yet in current §164.304 — narrows/formalizes what's currently only implicit within 'information system.'

C009.definition: encompass all of the administrative, physical, and technical safeguards in an information system
